title: [Runner] Fix false-positive Win+Shift+C shortcut conflict on Windows 11

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The literal suggestion candidate previously passed its focused validation; that result does not validate pristine upstream. The latest pristine restore attempt omitted the explicit project argument, so MSBuild selected the solution and failed restore-graph evaluation with an empty PlatformToolsetVersion. This is an invocation error, not evidence of a package-feed or product failure. Runner and unit-test builds, test discovery, and the original focused upstream test did not run. The command is being corrected before another assigned slot. Round 3 returned six Lite comments covering four distinct claims, with no demonstrated upstream correctness defect; full agentic review did not start. No review convergence is claimed. The corrected explicit-project argument array passed static checks, but execution is pending. Five of the six round-3 comments were resolved; the remaining thread concerns a test seam introduced by the private review candidate, not an upstream defect, and requires candidate cleanup and validation.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
